tools.name: preview_openapi_conversion
tools.description: Validate an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 schema (JSON or YAML text, for example the schema from a custom GPT Action) and show the MCP tools it converts to: tool names, HTTP method and path, read-only or destructive hints, detected authentication, and any errors or warnings. Use this when someone wants to migrate

tools.name: get_mcp_client_setup
tools.description: Step-by-step instructions for adding a remote MCP server URL to ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or the MCP Inspector, for a server that uses an access key, no authentication, or per-user OAuth sign-in.

tools.name: custom_gpt_retirement_guide
tools.description: Key dates for the retirement of custom GPTs in ChatGPT (December 2026), what migrates automatically and what does not (custom Actions), and a checklist for rebuilding an Action as a remote MCP server.
